career_ladder.note: Gram Sachivs (Panchayat Secretaries) serve in the Development and Panchayats Department, Haryana, functioning as the chief executive officer and accounting secretary for Gram Panchayats. Promotion rules are governed by the Haryana Development and Panchayats Department (Group C) Service Rules.

steps.source_label: HSSC Advt No. 03/2023 (Group 56 Graduate Level Posts) & Haryana Development and Panchayats Rules

steps.designation: Social Education and Panchayat Officer (SEPO) / Sub-Inspector Panchayats
steps.years: approx. 8-12 yrs (subject to departmental qualifying examination)
steps.source_label: Haryana Development and Panchayats Subordinate Services Promotion Rules
Haryana Rural Development Cadre Promotion Rules
Haryana Civil Services State Executive Cadre Rules

exam_scheme.note: Gram Sachiv recruitment is integrated under HSSC Group C Common Eligibility Test as part of Group 56 (Graduate Level Posts), requiring CET qualification followed by the Group 56 Mains Examination.

stages.stage_name: Common Eligibility Test (CET Group C Screening)
stages.source_label: HSSC CET Group C Notification & Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Screening Examination (General Awareness, Reasoning, Maths, Science, Languages & Haryana GK)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; 0.95 deducted if fifth bubble left blank
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying cutoff for shortlisting to Group 56 Mains

stages.stage_name: HSSC Group 56 Mains Written Examination (Graduate Level Posts)
stages.source_label: HSSC Group 56 Mains Examination Scheme & Detailed Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Subject-Specific Domain Knowledge (70% weightage: Haryana Panchayati Raj Act 1994, 73rd Constitutional Amendment, Gram Sabha Administration, Panchayat Accounting, Rural Development Schemes, SVAMITVA, PMAY-G, MGNREGA)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; mandatory fifth bubble

papers.paper_name: General Knowledge, Reasoning, Computer Literacy & Haryana History/Culture (30% weightage)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; mandatory fifth bubble

financial_package.note: Gram Sachivs in Haryana are placed in Functional Pay Level 4 (FPL-4) under Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016, with entry basic pay of ₹25,500.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 (FPL-4 scale ₹25,500 – ₹81,100)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on entry Level 4 basic pay of ₹25,500 with 58% Dearness Allowance (₹14,790), House Rent Allowance (8% to 24%), fixed medical allowance, and traveling conveyance allowance, minus standard employee NPS and insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) at prevailing state rates (58% effective 1 Jul 2025)
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by City Grade (X/Y/Z: 24%/16%/8%)
Fixed traveling and conveyance allowance for village inspections
Cashless Medical Facility Scheme under Government of Haryana
New Pension Scheme (NPS) with employer matching contribution
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per Haryana Civil Services Rules

competition_benchmarks.note: Gram Sachiv is one of the most competitive rural administration recruitments in Haryana, attracting graduates from across the state.
